source.title: Celestial Lighthouse (js13k 2021)
source.creator: Auroriax
source.source_mechanic: Place blocks on strange planets with circular gravity; move and place with the mouse and rotate with the wheel or arrows.

transformation.implementation: An original seeded 2D masonry workbench with a finite circular planet, keyed support sockets, visible tray blocks, and radial settling computed from drop geometry.
transformation.new_rules: Blocks are finite squares. On release, radial gravity projects the block inward along the release ray to the keyed contact radius, then the inward face must meet the planet or an occupied supporting block. Successful contacts become visible masonry; any block order satisfying the generated support dependencies and landing tolerance is accepted.
transformation.assets: No source assets copied; all visuals are original CSS, canvas geometry, labels, and generated colors.

license_notes: The benchmark implementation is an independent recreation of the surveyed generic mechanic and does not bundle the source game or its assets.
